question: Should OpenClaw add a default-off WebChat-to-last-external mirroring config, fold it into the broader origin-delivery policy at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/54531, or keep WebChat replies explicit-only?
rationale: The code path and missing config are clear, but the requested behavior intentionally crosses channel and privacy boundaries using stored route state, so automation cannot choose the product/security policy.

options.title: Define Shared Origin-Delivery Policy
options.body: Use this issue as the narrow WebChat mirroring requirement while defining shared route freshness, authorization, duplicate-delivery, and failure rules with the broader origin-delivery work.

options.title: Ship Narrow Default-Off Mirror Flag
options.body: Add the requested session config only if maintainers accept a separate WebChat mirroring policy and require schema/docs/tests plus live Discord or Telegram proof before merge.

options.title: Keep Explicit Delivery Only
options.body: Defer or close this feature if maintainers decide WebChat should not reuse stored external routes without an explicit per-message delivery route.

recommendation.title: Define Shared Origin-Delivery Policy
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the narrow WebChat mirroring requirement while defining shared route freshness, authorization, duplicate-delivery, and failure rules with the broader origin-delivery work.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the live assignee and has adjacent routing/delivery-context history, making this the best available owner for the product/security boundary choice.
